purpose: Collectible detail — complete 5-series badge collection set
prompt:
Collectible set photograph for 脸谱潮 LIANPU CHAO — the complete 5-series enamel pin collection displayed as a ceremonial set.

Scene: Five enamel pins arranged in a row on a dark ink-black #1a1a2e velvet display board, each in its own compartment. The five pins represent the five character series:

1. 忠义红 Loyalty Red (Guan Yu): Round pin, cinnabar-red #e8433f dominant, gold #d4a843 border, phoenix eye pattern
2. 刚直黑 Integrity Black (Bao Zheng): Round pin, ink-black #1a1a2e dominant, gold #d4a843 crescent moon on forehead, gold border
3. 智谋白 Wisdom White (Cao Cao): Round pin, rice-paper #f5f0e8 dominant face, ink-black #1a1a2e fine line details, sly expression, azurite-blue #2d6a8e accent
4. 刚强蓝 Fierce Blue (Dou Erdun): Round pin, azurite-blue #2d6a8e dominant, ink-black #1a1a2e outlines, fierce expression
5. 神话金银 Mythic Gold (Sun Wukong): Round pin, gold-leaf #d4a843 dominant, gamboge-yellow #f0b32d accents, monkey-like face pattern

Each pin has gold #d4a843 metal borders with raised lines. The five colors create a rainbow-like progression from red to gold. The arrangement has ritualistic, collectible feel — like a museum display or treasure set.

Style: Product photography on dark velvet, dramatic lighting highlighting the enamel gloss and metal luster. Each pin is sharp and detailed. The set feels premium and complete.
